state_convention.state_as_integer: 16 hexadecimal digits; bit 0 is the least-significant bit and nibble 0 is the least-significant hexadecimal digit

master_key_convention.integer_words: K = k7 || k6 || ... || k0, where word k0 occupies master-key bits 0..15 and word k7 occupies bits 112..127
master_key_convention.bit_names: k_i denotes bit i of the 128-bit master-key integer, with k_0 the least-significant bit

round_key.injection: for nibble i=0..15, XOR U_i into state bit 4*i+1 and V_i into state bit 4*i

round_constants.injection: XOR 1 into state bit 63; XOR c0,c1,c2,c3,c4,c5 into state bits 23,19,15,11,7,3 respectively

fixed_characteristic.state_location: input of SubCells in each round; item 12 is the state after round 11

fixed_master_key_for_exact_count.meaning: the 128-bit master-key integer has only bit k_12 set

counting_semantics.oriented_plaintext: count x in {0,1}^64 such that x and x xor input_difference follow every listed round difference
counting_semantics.right_key_fraction: 2^(-rank) when the derived affine master-key equations are consistent and independent rank is rank
